object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G61 (D-G32), Q-G12; review Q64. Decided on 2026-11-11: refuse rather than support long paths, since Git for Windows checks such paths out only where core.longpaths is set on each teammate's machine. STORE may take it, beside MELLON-STORE-SRS-225.
object.description: If a file that an edit writes has a full path longer than 259 characters, Mellon shall refuse the edit, naming the file.
